question: On 9 April 2024, the European Parliament discussed a Commission report1 on public media financing. On page 83, Spain is cited as an example of the fact that, without transparency and principles of equal treatment and free competition, media aligned with the government are controlled and rewarded.

What is more, of all the Member States, Spain ranked third from last in terms of trust in its public media (page 132) as well as in terms of having media free from political influence (page 140). Finally, the study cites Spain as an example of a country with poor quality consolidated information, owing to its regional model (pages 26 and 75).

It also highlights that such a model leads to large differences between regions (page 102), with three receiving more media subsidies (Catalonia, the Basque Country and Galicia, page 74). In light of this: 1.
Does the Commission intend to take any action relating to the situation in Spain described on page 83?
Does the Commission intend to take any action relating to the situation in Spain described on pages 132 and 140?
Does the Commission plan to take any action in response to the regional chaos and inequality in Spain?
